feeds.title: BANFF MOMENTS
feeds.description: BANFF MOMENTS is a captivating blog that showcases the stunning landscapes, adventurous spirit, and vibrant culture of Banff National Park. Founded by passionate photographer Amar, the blog takes readers on a visual journey through the awe-inspiring beauty of the Canadian Rockies.

feeds.title: Tofino Photography
feeds.description: Tofino Photography is a blog that celebrates the natural wonders and coastal charm of Tofino, a small town nestled on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, Canada. Founded by a passionate photographer, the blog showcases the mesmerizing beauty of Tofino's beaches, ancient rainforests, and diverse wildlife.

feeds.title: Michael Russell Photography Blog
feeds.description: Michael Russell is a British Columbia photographer that was born in North Vancouver next to the peaks of the Pacific Coast Range. His photographic interests are landscapes and nature though he does photograph wildlife and architecture when finds them. The blog showcases his captivating imagery, accompanied by narratives that provide insights into the places he has visited.

feeds.title: Follow Me North Blog
feeds.description: Follow Me North Blog is an adventure-filled blog that explores the untamed wilderness and northern landscapes of Canada. Founded by a duo, Jesse & Susan, of intrepid photographers and outdoor enthusiasts, Follow Me North specializes in Wildlife and Landscape Photography Workshops in Algonquin Park and beyond.

feeds.title: Natural Images Canada Blog
feeds.description: Natural Images Canada Blog is a nature photography blog and portfolio by Terry Venables. The website features a wide variety of wildlife photography, including hummingbirds, herons, owls, dragons, little eagles, otters, ravens, and more. The blog also includes information about Terry's photography equipment and techniques, as well as links to his social media accounts.

feeds.title: Catherine Babault Photography Blog
feeds.description: An award-winning Vancouver Island-based nature photographer, Catherine Babault shares her passion for nature photography and conservation in her photo tours and workshops on Vancouver Island, public presentations, and books. Get the latest news about upcoming nature and wildlife photography tours and workshops on Vancouver Island, photo techniques, photo books release, image licensing, and prints from Catherine Babault Photography.

feeds.title: NATURE PHOTOGRAPHY BLOG
feeds.description: Chris has combined his life-long passion for nature with highly technical expertise to become one of the top nature photographers of the time. He has over 35 years experience as a full-time freelance nature and wildlife photographer, nature photography workshop & safari leader, photography educator, blogger, and lecturer.

feeds.title: Mountains and Treasures Blog
feeds.description: Steve McLaughlin is a Canadian nature photographer based in Canmore, Alberta, which is right down the road from Banff! His camera became the perfect companion as he documented his animal neighbors. His keen eye for composition and patience in observing his subjects shows through his beautiful imagery. Mountains and Treasures Blog is a treasure trove of visual storytelling, dedicated to capturing the awe-inspiring beauty of mountains around the world.

feeds.title: Kerri Martin Photography Blog
feeds.description: Kerri Martin is a passionate animal lover, writer, and photographer, and her goal is to inspire people to connect to the natural world from a place of deep respect and appreciation. She believes grounding ourselves within the intricate yet simplistic beauty of our non-human counterparts allows us to see our true place within the larger structure of biodiversity.

feeds.title: Wildlife Photo Images
feeds.description: Wildlife Photo Images is a captivating blog dedicated to the art of wildlife photography. Founded by a passionate wildlife photographer, Eric Seemann the blog features articles, stories, and musings. Eric brings you exclusive, original wildlife art - an intimate, emotional encounter with nature.
